INSIDE THE MODEL

What goes into a pick

The factors, the testing, and a place to keep your ideas.

NBA + NFL

Core inputs

IN USE
  • Team strengthElo ratings update from final scores and opponent strength.
  • Home advantageAccounts for the home team; NFL neutral-site games are treated separately.
  • Team forecastThe team forecast uses game results and opponent strength; the odds are compared afterward. It has not yet been calibrated.
  • Available oddsAt least three books, the best available price and time until tipoff or kickoff help determine which picks qualify.

NBA + NFL

Factors under research

PAUSED

Waiting for the latest model details.

Rest and recent scoring margin are paused while we prepare stronger tests. A new factor needs preregistration, multiple-season replication, an untouched holdout, and a comparison with the market before it can enter the model. No result guarantees profit.

ON THE RADAR

Tracked, but not model inputs

NOT IN USE
Referee assignments

NBA crews are archived when available; NFL history is researched. Assignments can change and their effects are unvalidated.

Injuries, lineups & quarterbacks

NFL reports are archived for research; availability and projected lineups are not directly incorporated. Sportsbook prices may already reflect news.

Travel & time zones

Schedule features are under research and do not change picks.
